[[Category:Senate Motion]][[Category:385YE Autumn]]
__NOTOC__
<quote by="Proposed: Segura, Seconded: Weirwater">To commission the Red Depths in Kahraman as a Brass Coast National Bourse seat, self funded by the virtuous citizens of the Brass Coast.</quote>
==Overview==
* Creates a [[mithril]] seat in [[Kahraman]] as per the '''[[Landscape#The_Red_Depths|Landscape]]''' wind of fortune
* Passed
==Date==
* Autumn 385YE
==Cost==
* Costs as per the wind of fortune
* 50 thrones
* Three months to complete; due to the [[Against_the_Jotun#Hill|disruption caused by the Lasambrian Orcs]] after the Autumn Equinox, completion on the Red Depths has been delayed.
* 10 thrones seasonal upkeep

==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Red_Depths}}
==Outcome==
* Due to the [[Against_the_Jotun#Hill|disruption caused by the Lasambrian Orcs]] after the Autumn Equinox, completion on the Red Depths has been delayed until at least the start of the Spring Equinox 385YE at the earliest.
* Once complete [[the Red Depths]] will be elected by [[Tally of the Votes]] by the [[fleet|fleets]] of the Brass Coast.
